description: US Representative Feeder Sets for Distribution Grid Economics and Policy Applications - Alameda County, CA Case Study is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Albane Seres. This dataset presents the distribution networks developed in our unpublished paper, "US Representative Feeder Sets for Distribution Grid Economics and Policy Applications." In the paper, we generate feeder sets that reproduce the economic characteristics of local distribution grids by starting from prototypical feeders that represent the electric installations in a specific location. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
